## Why visit

One of the most purposeful cider stops around Bolton. Three rotating casks and specialist keg sit alongside handpumped, boxed and bottled cider, with producers not routinely found elsewhere in the area. Bolton CAMRA named it Cider Pub of the Year 2026. The compact modern room pairs easily with Bank Top Ale House; let the cider list decide whether a Horwich afternoon beats another town trip.

## Beer

Three changing cask from independent breweries, plus keg featuring local producers including Rivington.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA lists later opening Monday/Tuesday (around 18:00) and earlier on other weekdays. A deep step at entrance and limited space are recorded.

**Getting there:** Horwich centre; bus connections from Bolton Interchange, then walk between Lee Lane and Church Street.
